snippet.title: SONIC THE HEDGEHOG: EVO - Public Release  v1.0-
snippet.description:
This is a project I’ve been working on for the past couple of years as a hobby, and I finally feel like I have something worth sharing with the public.

Keep in mind this is still a very early build, but I plan to keep updating it with new levels, menus, characters, and systems, so stay tuned!

Subscribe to get updates about the game!

Q&A​
Where is the level shown in the trailer? – Due to time constrains only the Test Stage is playable for now, proper levels will come with future updates!​
Is this Project Hero? – I'm in no way associated with Hero! But his game really is what inspired me to start working on this project.​
Can you change X thing? – Feedback is always appreciated! You can leave yours in the comments as long as you're respectful and I'll try to tweak what I can.​
Controls? – Please check out the "Controls and Stuff Readme" located in the game files. Proper tutorials will come once stage levels are a thing.​
Where are my photos stored? – All photos are stored within the game's folder under STH_EVO_Data.​

Download Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FsDNm25C84PcC9hyZYGZDC5ud7reGWvw?usp=drive_link
Also available at SAGE: https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/sonic-the-hedgehog-evo-sage-2025-demo.2751
